text:
The evidence does **not establish whether the 67.7 ha lost in 2020 was deforestation**. Tree-cover loss alone does not show whether forest was permanently converted to another land use.

The loss occurred before the tool’s 31 December 2020 baseline, so it is recorded as history rather than assessed as a post-baseline event. The JRC reference mapped no forest on the property in 2020, but that does not establish what the lost trees were or how the land was used afterward.

After the baseline, the tool reported only 0.4 ha of loss in 2021, in patches below its 0.5 ha event threshold.
